description: Teaching artifacts: the 'same SQS orders queue three ways' reference set (raw CloudFormation JSON, CDK TypeScript construct, SAM resource) with an explanatory README, plus the Kiro v1 hook JSON that triggers unit-test generation on Python file save. Inspectable, not deployed. The CDK snippet must mirror the queue defined in FEAT-001.
steps: Create <ROOT>/reference/orders-queue.cfn.json: raw CloudFormation AWS::SQS::Queue JSON for the orders queue.
Create <ROOT>/reference/orders-queue-cdk.ts: CDK TypeScript new sqs.Queue(...) snippet matching the queue in <ROOT>/infra/lib/network-data-stack.ts.
Create <ROOT>/reference/orders-queue.sam.yaml: the same queue as a SAM/CloudFormation AWS::SQS::Queue resource.
Create <ROOT>/reference/README.md explaining these three files are the 'declare the same queue three ways' teaching artifact and are not deployed.

Create <ROOT>/.kiro/hooks/generate-tests-on-save.kiro.hook: standalone v1 hook JSON (fields: version, enabled true, when.type PostFileSave with patterns including \.py$, then.type agent with a prompt to generate/update unit tests). Matcher per task: trigger PostFileSave, matcher \.py$, action type agent.
acceptance_criteria: reference/orders-queue.cfn.json parses as JSON and declares AWS::SQS::Queue
reference/orders-queue.sam.yaml parses as YAML and declares AWS::SQS::Queue
The CDK snippet matches the queue construct used in network-data-stack.ts
The .kiro.hook file parses as JSON and matches the v1 hook schema (PostFileSave trigger, \.py$ matcher, agent action)
findings:
All five teaching artifacts created and verified (inspectable only, not deployed). The 'same queue three ways' set mirrors the real OrdersQueue in infra/lib/network-data-stack.ts: queueName 'coffee-ship-orders', VisibilityTimeout 60s, MessageRetentionPeriod 345600s (4 days).

FILES:
- reference/orders-queue.cfn.json: raw CloudFormation template (AWSTemplateFormatVersion 2010-09-09) with Resources.OrdersQueue (Type AWS::SQS::Queue, QueueName/VisibilityTimeout 60/MessageRetentionPeriod 345600) and Outputs OrdersQueueUrl (Ref) + OrdersQueueArn (Fn::GetAtt).
- reference/orders-queue-cdk.ts: CDK TS snippet. OrdersQueueExample extends Construct, creates new sqs.Queue(this,'OrdersQueue',{queueName:'coffee-ship-orders', visibilityTimeout: cdk.Duration.seconds(60), retentionPeriod: cdk.Duration.days(4)}) - identical props to network-data-stack.ts.
- reference/orders-queue.sam.yaml: SAM template (Transform AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31) with same OrdersQueue resource + outputs using !Ref / !GetAtt.
- reference/README.md: explains the 'declare the same queue three ways' comparison table, lists shared settings, links the three files + the real infra stack, and states none are deployed.
- .kiro/hooks/generate-tests-on-save.kiro.hook: v1 hook JSON. version '1', enabled true, when.type PostFileSave with patterns ['\\.py$'], then.type agent with a prompt to generate/update unit tests for the saved Python file (tests only, no source edits).

VERIFICATION (local, nothing deployed): CFN_JSON_OK (json.load), HOOK_OK (json.load + v1 schema asserts: version/enabled/when.type PostFileSave/\\.py$ pattern/then.type agent). SAM YAML: yaml.safe_load fails on SAM intrinsic tags (!Ref/!GetAtt) by design, so parsed with a permissive multi-constructor loader for '!' tags per context.json verification note - SAM_YAML_OK, OrdersQueue Type AWS::SQS::Queue confirmed. No deploy/bootstrap/aws commands run.
